title: My Journey into Software Development
paragraphs: My interest in software development began during my studies in computer applications. Through academic projects and practical learning, I developed an interest in creating software solutions and exploring new technologies.
I am continuing to develop my knowledge of programming, web development, software engineering, and modern technologies as I progress through my studies.

title: Learning React
paragraphs: Learning React has introduced me to component-based development and a different way of building web applications.
While developing this portfolio, I have learned about React components, routing, state management, and organising a project into reusable sections.

title: Building My Portfolio
paragraphs: Developing this portfolio has given me an opportunity to apply software engineering concepts in a practical project.
The portfolio has evolved through different stages, including creating individual pages, introducing reusable components, adding navigation, and developing interactive features.
